result.instructions: Tools for Moxie, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which clients in Moxie have an invoice that is still open?"; "Log a 120 EUR expense for Adobe stock photos and bill it to Acme Kft."; "Show all time entries for Acme's projects in October.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Moxie data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run moxie_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run moxie_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run moxie_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. moxie_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: moxie_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List active clients in the workspace with their contacts, address, tax and billing details. Moxie API: GET /clients/list.

tools.name: moxie_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Find active clients by an exact id, or by free text matched on the client name, phone, or contact email and name. Moxie API: GET /clients/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client in the workspace. Only the name is required. Moxie API: POST /clients/create.

tools.name: moxie_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on an existing client (partial update; omitted fields stay as they are). The tool never sends a full replace. Moxie API: PATCH /clients/update.

tools.name: moxie_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: List or search active contacts by email, first name, or last name. Omit query to list all. Moxie API: GET /contacts/search.

tools.name: moxie_search_projects
tools.title: Search projects
tools.description: List active projects, or the projects of one client by its exact name. Set includeArchived to add archived projects. Moxie API: GET /projects/search.

tools.name: moxie_list_project_notes
tools.title: List project notes
tools.description: List the private workspace notes of one project, newest first. Moxie API: GET /projects/notes/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_project_note
tools.title: Create a project note
tools.description: Add a private note to a project. The note body is replaced only by moxie_update_project_note. Moxie API: POST /projects/notes/create.

tools.name: moxie_update_project_note
tools.title: Update a project note
tools.description: Replace the body of an existing project note (not an append). Moxie API: PATCH /projects/notes/update.

tools.name: moxie_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List completed time entries in a time window, with filters by user, client, project, task, or ticket. The maximum is 10,000 entries per call; narrow the window when a call returns that many. Moxie API: GET /timeWorked/list.

latest.description: Inclusive end of the window. Must not precede earliest.

includeEndDate.description: Also match entries whose end falls in the window. Default false.

tools.name: moxie_list_open_invoices
tools.title: List open invoices
tools.description: List outstanding (payable) invoices, optionally for one client by its exact name, or one invoice by id. Moxie API: GET /payableInvoices/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_expense
tools.title: Create an expense
tools.description: Record an expense, optionally billable to a client with a markup. Moxie API: POST /expenses/create.

date.description: Expense date as an RFC-3339 datetime, e.g. 2026-07-08T00:00:00Z.

markupPercentage.description: Markup when billed to a client.

reimbursable.description: Whether it is reimbursable or billable.

tools.name: moxie_search_opportunities
tools.title: Search opportunities
tools.description: Find pipeline opportunities by text, client, stage, or status. Archived records are included only by status ARCHIVED or includeArchived. Moxie API: GET /opportunities/search.

query.description: Substring of the name or description.

tools.name: moxie_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity in the pipeline. Moxie API: POST /opportunities/create.

tools.name: moxie_search_agreements
tools.title: Search agreements
tools.description: List agreements in the workspace, or the agreements of one client. Read-only: Moxie does not allow agreement writes through the API. Moxie API: GET /agreements/search.

tools.name: moxie_get_account
tools.title: Get the workspace account
tools.description: Get the supplier identity of the workspace (name, address, tax id, currency) for an accountId seen on invoices. Moxie API: GET /account/{accountId}.

accountId.description: Workspace account id, as on invoice payloads.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Moxie
prompts.description: What you can do with Moxie here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_invoices_for_a_client
prompts.title: Find open invoices for a client
prompts.description: List the outstanding invoices, or the invoices of one client by its exact name. Search clients to find the exact name.

prompts.name: review_time_logged_on_client_projects
prompts.title: Review time logged on client projects
prompts.description: Find a project by name. List completed time entries in a time window, filtered by user, client or project. Each call returns up to 10,000 entries.

prompts.name: read_private_project_notes
prompts.title: Read private project notes
prompts.description: Find a project by name. Read its private workspace notes, newest first.

prompts.name: add_or_update_a_project_note
prompts.title: Add or update a project note
prompts.description: Add a private note to a project. Update a note to replace its body. An update does not add text to the existing body.

prompts.name: record_a_billable_expense_for_a_client
prompts.title: Record a billable expense for a client
prompts.description: Find the client. Record an expense, billable to the client with a markup if needed.

prompts.name: track_sales_opportunities
prompts.title: Track sales opportunities
prompts.description: Search the pipeline by text, client, stage or status. Create a sales opportunity when a new lead comes in.
